_comment: DriveAware configuration — edit values and press F5 to hot-reload at runtime.
_CAMERA_WARMUP_SECONDS: Delay after camera open for sensor stabilization. Arbitrary, needs validation.
_DETECTION_SCALE_WIDTH: Downscale frame width before face detection for performance. Empirical.
_FACE_DETECTION_CONFIDENCE: MediaPipe minimum face detection confidence. MediaPipe default.
_MAR_THRESHOLD: Mouth Aspect Ratio threshold for open-mouth detection. Empirical, tuned on single subject. Typical closed mouth ~0.2–0.3, yawn ~0.5–0.8.
_MAR_SUSTAINED_FRAMES: Number of frames mouth must stay open (~1.5s at 15fps). Empirical.
_MAR_COOLDOWN_SECONDS: Minimum interval between yawn triggers to prevent double-counting. Empirical.
_MP_MAX_NUM_FACES: MediaPipe max faces to track. 1 is sufficient for driver monitoring.
_MP_REFINE_LANDMARKS: Enable MediaPipe landmark refinement (attention mesh). Improves accuracy at slight performance cost.
_AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE: Target audio sample rate for recording. Whisper native rate.
_AUDIO_DURATION_SECONDS: Max recording window for yawn-triggered voice capture (20s). Recording stops early if keyword matched.
_LISTEN_CHUNK_SECONDS: Duration of each recording segment. 4s chunks, up to 5 rounds within the 20s window.
_MAX_RETRIES: Max retry count for unrecognized intent before abandoning the inquiry.
_VAD_CHUNK_SECONDS: Audio chunk size for continuous VAD. 200ms balances latency and stability. Empirical.
_VAD_SPEECH_THRESHOLD: Absolute RMS floor for speech detection. Needs environment-specific tuning.
_VAD_NOISE_MULTIPLIER: Adaptive threshold = max(SPEECH_THRESHOLD, noise_floor × MULTIPLIER). Empirical.
_VAD_SPEECH_START_FRAMES: Consecutive speech chunks to trigger recording (600ms). Empirical.
_VAD_SILENCE_END_FRAMES: Consecutive silence chunks to stop recording (3s). Empirical.
_VAD_COOLDOWN_SECONDS: Minimum silence after a command before listening again.
_WHISPER_MODEL_SIZE: Whisper model size: tiny, base, small, medium, large. 'small' balances speed and accuracy.
_DEEPSEEK_MODEL: DeepSeek model name for intent classification.
_TTS_RATE: TTS speech rate (words per minute). Empirical comfort level.
_TTS_SPEECH_TIMEOUT: Max seconds to wait for TTS before force-completion. Safety guard.
_DYNAMIC_COLOR: Ambient color for Dynamic mode (warm orange).
_REST_COLOR: Ambient color for Rest mode (cool blue).
_DYNAMIC_AC_TEMP: Virtual AC temperature for Dynamic mode (celsius).
_REST_AC_TEMP: Virtual AC temperature for Rest mode (celsius).
_COLOR_TRANSITION_SPEED: RGB steps per frame during color transitions.
PROMPT_INQUIRY: You seem relaxed. Would you like to change to Dynamic Mode?
_PROMPT_INQUIRY: TTS prompt when system detects relaxation and asks for mode switch.
_PROMPT_CONFIRM_DYNAMIC: TTS confirmation when switching to Dynamic mode.
_PROMPT_CONFIRM_REST: TTS confirmation when user chooses to stay in Rest mode.
PROMPT_UNKNOWN: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you say that again?
_PROMPT_UNKNOWN: TTS retry prompt when speech was detected but intent could not be understood.
PROMPT_SILENCE: I didn't hear anything. Would you like to change to Dynamic Mode?
_PROMPT_SILENCE: TTS retry prompt when no speech was detected during the entire recording window.
PROMPT_RETRY_EXHAUSTED: I couldn't understand. Please use the keyboard to select a mode.
_PROMPT_RETRY_EXHAUSTED: TTS fallback when all voice retries exhausted.
